answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 65 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes an orchard bet on surviving 65 epochs of grading, and every prism settlement recomputes the reef schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is thus worth nothing for 17 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 35 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
